_template.purpose: AS-10 experimental input template, not measured data and not synthetic trajectories
_template.instructions: Replace every required null and REQUIRED marker with independently measured or explicitly justified values/sources. Two bodies and three times are structural placeholders. Do not infer field values from species or published beta tables. Keep unknown standard_uncertainty null rather than inventing zero.
_template.body_limit: This schema supports midpoint COM on a uniform grid only. Confirm that assumption or do not use this model.
_template.calibration_limit: Supply calibrated pre-contact x,z tracks, initial-state time origin, original video/calibration references and actual lowercase SHA256 digests. Asset references/digests below are intentionally null.
_template.identification_limit: Fill numerical tolerances/search bounds from a documented research protocol; they are settings, not measured tree properties. Every observation must precede first contact. No missing/invisible tracks are supported.

body.midpoint_assumption: REQUIRED: measured or explicitly justified midpoint COM for each full stem-plus-crown body

lengths_m.source: REQUIRED: measured equal body lengths and specimen subdivision

diameters_m.source: REQUIRED: measured midpoint diameters, not radii

joint_diameters_m.source: REQUIRED: section diameter at the actual connection

masses_kg.source: REQUIRED: full measured stem-plus-crown body masses

inertias_kg_m2.source: REQUIRED: mass inertias about each supplied midpoint COM, including crown contribution

elastic_modulus_pa.source: REQUIRED: independently measured or explicitly justified elastic modulus

base_position_m.source: REQUIRED: calibrated fixed-hinge x,z origin in the common frame

gravity_m_s2.source: REQUIRED: declared gravity and its justification

ground_z_m.source: REQUIRED: calibrated horizontal ground plane in the common frame

air_velocity_m_s.source: REQUIRED: measured or explicitly assumed constant air x,z velocity; set air_model=still only with explicit zero-velocity assumption

initial_angles_rad.source: REQUIRED: calibrated initial absolute body angles from upward vertical

initial_angular_velocities_rad_s.source: REQUIRED: independently supplied initial angular velocities; do not substitute implicit zero

load_profile.source: REQUIRED: selected measured crown-mass distribution and provenance

crown_masses_kg.source: REQUIRED: measured nonnegative crown masses, included in full body masses, with positive total

times_s.source: REQUIRED: calibrated increasing timestamps starting at supplied initial-state t=0

positions_m.source: REQUIRED: calibrated COM x,z coordinates for each time and selected body

calibration.source: REQUIRED: original experiment and camera calibration
calibration.metric_mapping: REQUIRED: pixel-to-world x,z mapping, distortion correction and independent scale
calibration.time_origin_description: REQUIRED: definition and synchronization of t=0 with supplied theta0/omega0
calibration.plane_assumption: REQUIRED: evidence for motion in the calibrated x,z plane and fixed hinge
calibration.uncertainty_note: REQUIRED: coordinate, timestamp, scale and physical-point uncertainty; unknown terms must be identified

identification.bounds_reason: REQUIRED: finite nonnegative research search interval and its basis; no species/table beta constants
identification.tolerance_reason: REQUIRED: documented numerical error budget and physically relevant tolerances
